enemy-053-albino-ovomorph.name: Albino Ovomorph
enemy-053-albino-ovomorph.designLock: Exact systemic derivative of the locked V66 Ovomorph anatomy: same upright leathery ovoid, broad stable lower shell, narrower cap, exactly four apical lips, no root tentacles, no legs, no parasite baked into the egg, and identical sealed/opening/release/destroyed logic. Albino changes only authored pigmentation and material response: warm bone-ivory and pale gray-beige outer membrane with restrained translucent pink-beige veins and interior, subtle wet highlights and enough value separation to preserve pebbled relief. It is not pure white, glowing, crystalline or a flat automatic recolor. No new caste or official-model claim. Strict right-facing contract, unchanged scale, root and silhouette. Future pixels must be an original hand-authored adaptation of the base lock.
